A framebuffer of OpenGL with a color texture and a 24-bit depth renderbuffer, without stencil.

<a id="GlFrameBuffer-constructor"></a>

### GlFrameBuffer

`GlFrameBuffer(GlRenderBridge bridge, int width, int height)` 

Creates the framebuffer, its color texture and its depth renderbuffer at that size in pixels; [`GlRenderBridge.createFrameBuffer`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/#GlRenderBridge-method-createFrameBuffer) calls it.
